name: Bahareh Abbasi
title: Associate Professor - Mechatronics Engineering
fitReason: Applied AI/HRI fit spanning neural dialogue interpretation, reinforcement-learned interaction policies and a local GPT-4o/Sawyer prototype. A short project could potentially focus on perception, language grounding or evaluation, but that is a proposed fit rather than an advertised research visit.

physicalEvidence.summary: The complete July 2025 International Journal of Social Robotics article verifies DAgger-initialized DQN interaction management on a real Baxter, with ALBERT dialogue-act classification, speech/gesture inputs and executed pointing, drawer manipulation and object presentation. Its study involved 12 healthy adults and 75 trials. This is UIC-led collaborative hardware: the same study and core results already appear in the August 2024 preprint. A September 2026 preprint retells the experiment and is not counted as a newly executed study. Separately, CSUCI’s May 2025 undergraduate research publication describes Abbasi/Isaacs-supervised 2024 work integrating GPT-4o, speech services and ROS Melodic with a local Sawyer for a closed-loop teaching/correction prototype; formal human-subject testing was future work. Its linked student repository independently names both faculty mentors. The local report is a prototype/poster, not a peer-reviewed full experimental evaluation.

shortVisit.summary: No explicit external-master visiting invitation was verified. CSUCI’s eight-week 2026 SURF is restricted to continuing local undergraduates and explicitly excludes graduate students. Prior SURF mentorship and local master’s thesis supervision do not establish a separate summer 2027 opening.

scoreReasons.fit: 36/40: concrete deep-RL, neural language interpretation and multimodal assistive interaction.

scoreReasons.shortVisit: 0/20: no current external-master invitation; local SURF is inapplicable.
